smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: ArchitectGPT
shortDescription: Turns a room photo or a floor plan into a photoreal render. Basic is $29 a month.
longDescription: ArchitectGPT restyles a room photo or an exterior photo, and on Pro it turns a plan image or a DWG or DXF file into a furnished top-down render. Basic is $29 a month for 300 generations. Standard is $59 a month for 1,000 generations. Pro is $99 a month and is the plan that includes floor plan rendering. Premium is $149 a month.
pricingNotes: Basic is $29 per month for 300 generations. Standard is $59 per month for 1,000 generations. Pro is $99 per month and includes floor plan rendering. Premium is $149 per month.
bestFor: A room or exterior photo that should become a redesign

notIdealFor: Floor plan rendering on the $29 Basic plan

strength: ArchitectGPT turns a room photo into a redesign and, on Pro, a floor plan image into a furnished render.
weakness: Floor plan rendering is listed on Pro at $99 per month, not on the $29 Basic plan.
